title: Genesis 21:12 — through Isaac your descendants shall be named
summary: Genesis 21:12: God tells Abraham not to be distressed over the lad and his maid, to listen to whatever Sarah says, because through Isaac his descendants shall be named. 'God' and 'Abraham' are in blue (with God also red and yellow), 'lad' in green, Sarah and 'her' in magenta, and Isaac in red.

text.text: 12 But God said to Abraham, “Do not be distressed because of the lad and your maid; whatever Sarah tells you, listen to her, for through Isaac your descendants shall be named.

keywords: in Isaac shall thy seed be called
